scripts.setup:auth: npm run build -w @brevo-miniapp/contracts && npm run build -w @brevo-miniapp/api && node scripts/setup-auth.mjs
scripts.build: npm run build -w @brevo-miniapp/contracts && npm run build -w @brevo-miniapp/web && npm run build -w @brevo-miniapp/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @brevo-miniapp/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @brevo-miniapp/contracts && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && node scripts/check-boundaries.mjs
